summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The operations level is covered in polished StarTrust wellness banners. Middle image: Kreeb studies the program packet with sincere interest. Closing image: Zib taps the wall.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The operations level is covered in polished StarTrust wellness banners.
PANEL 2 — Astra reads the participation line twice.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb studies the program packet with sincere interest.
PANEL 4 — Zib is standing behind the banner, staring at a service panel it partly covers.
PANEL 5 — Zib taps the wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: That is at least one contradiction before coffee.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: There may be one useful thing in here.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: There is one useful thing behind it.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: The room has been converted for Wellness Baseline Week; the largest portable screen and chair semicircle block the ventilation-damper service chase. Middle image: Zib shows Astra the maintenance ticket and the room schedule occupying the same hours. Closing image: Astra chooses to let the morning session start before service, creating the physical problem that will drive the day.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The multipurpose room is dressed for Wellness Baseline Week; a portable screen and chair semicircle block the ventilation-damper service chase.
PANEL 2 — Zib holds up the damper service ticket beside the blocked panel.
PANEL 3 — Pixa displays a morning schedule with nearly every access window occupied by wellness blocks.
PANEL 4 — Zib points to the current room temperature and the service estimate: ten minutes.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the already-arriving chairs, then at the service ticket.
PANEL 6 — Astra tells Zib to take the first open gap after the morning session. Zib marks the delay.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Can it wait through one block?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Quiet Room. Opening image: Kreeb prepares an adjacent quiet room as a genuine alternative space rather than another programmed activity. Middle image: Glorp arrives with the required-use tracking sheet. Closing image: Kreeb keeps the form outside the room and allows Pixa to count only anonymous foot traffic.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Kreeb sets up an adjacent quiet room with ordinary chairs, water and no corporate slogans.
PANEL 2 — Glorp arrives with the wellness-program usage form.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb points to the hallway table rather than allowing the form inside.
PANEL 4 — Glorp notes that room use still has to be counted.
PANEL 5 — Pixa offers anonymous foot-traffic count with no identity or disclosure.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb opens the door and leaves the room itself blank.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Use still has to be counted.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: I dislike how reasonable that is.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Jax's required tracker records a mindful pause while he is simply waiting for a cargo lift. Middle image: Jax tests whether the device can distinguish wellness from ordinary delay and learns that it cannot. Closing image: Astra passes without turning the joke into policy; the real problem is still waiting in the multipurpose room.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax waits beside a cargo lift with a parts cart.
PANEL 2 — His wellness tracker flashes MINDFUL PAUSE RECORDED.
PANEL 3 — Jax takes one deliberate extra breath to see whether anything changes.
PANEL 4 — Nothing changes except the timer.
PANEL 5 — Astra passes with the multipurpose-room schedule under her arm.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I was waiting for the lift.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Then I have mastered wellness accidentally.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Do not become a case study.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: Noola arrives for the required session in her water-dome rig and immediately notices the room is warmer and the air less active than normal. Middle image: She asks whether the room always feels like this; Zib points to the blocked damper chase. Closing image: Astra sees the abstract maintenance delay become a specific coworker's physical comfort problem.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Noola enters the multipurpose room in her water-dome rig as people settle into the chair semicircle.
PANEL 2 — Condensation is heavier than normal on the dome and Noola adjusts a local cooling control.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb notices her checking the room rather than the wellness materials.
PANEL 4 — Noola asks whether the room is usually this warm.
PANEL 5 — Zib points to the wellness screen blocking the damper service chase.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at Noola's cooling readout, then at the schedule she chose to protect.

dialogueInline.speaker: NOOLA
dialogueInline.text: Is it always this warm in here?

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Not when I can reach the wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: You can use the quiet room.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: Before the session begins, Mira builds a deliberately boring environmental log because the room already has a confounding maintenance condition. Middle image: She records temperature, equipment load, attendance and exits, refusing any inferred feeling fields. Closing image: Astra accepts that the official baseline is already scientifically compromised before the first breathing exercise.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira tapes a small physical observation sheet beside the room controls.
PANEL 2 — She records ambient temperature, equipment load, attendance and exits.
PANEL 3 — Pixa offers the program's staff-condition fields.
PANEL 4 — Mira dismisses them and points to the blocked service chase.
PANEL 5 — Astra asks whether the session can still produce a valid baseline.
PANEL 6 — Mira says it can produce a record of what happened in this room, not a clean wellness effect.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Can we still call this a baseline?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: The required session begins while the temperature is already above normal. Middle image: The synthetic calm track competes with the ventilation noise and Noola shifts her cooling setting again. Closing image: Astra keeps the session running because she still believes she can finish the block before the delayed maintenance matters.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The session starts; corporate calm tones play from the portable speaker mounted directly in front of the service chase.
PANEL 2 — Pixa starts the required participation clock.
PANEL 3 — Zib watches the room-temperature readout rise another fraction.
PANEL 4 — Noola increases cooling in her water-dome rig.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb notices several people shifting uncomfortably in their chairs.
PANEL 6 — Astra checks the remaining session time and chooses not to interrupt yet.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We are not locking anybody in a wellness room.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: Twenty minutes later, the room is visibly warmer. Noola decides she has had enough and leaves without asking permission or framing it as a statement. Middle image: Two other workers follow for their own comfort. Closing image: Pixa reports the exit rate while Mira reports the temperature; Astra finally has to treat the two facts as the same operational event.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The room is hotter; Noola checks her dome temperature once and stands.
PANEL 2 — Kreeb opens the door without asking why.
PANEL 3 — Noola leaves for the quiet room. Two other workers follow after a beat.
PANEL 4 — Pixa records session exits while Mira records a three-degree temperature rise.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the blocked service chase.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: More participants choose the doorway over the session as the heat rises. Middle image: Astra realizes the remaining choice is not baseline completeness versus maintenance convenience; it is whether to keep people in a room she knows is physically wrong. Closing image: She ends the block and gives Zib the room.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Another worker leaves; Jax is already standing near the door.
PANEL 2 — Astra looks at the participation clock: forty minutes remain.
PANEL 3 — Zib points to the blocked chase without repeating his argument.
PANEL 4 — Mira shows the environmental log; the baseline is already contaminated by the known maintenance condition.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb begins stacking chairs away from the door before Astra speaks.
PANEL 6 — Astra cancels the block and tells Zib to take the wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: This is not a clean baseline anymore.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: The wellness room becomes a work site in under a minute. Middle image: Jax and Kreeb move the screen and chairs clear while Zib opens the chase. Closing image: The corporate placard HONOR THE PRESENT MOMENT ends up leaning against a tool case while actual work begins.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa ends the session timer.
PANEL 2 — Jax unplugs the speaker and wheels it clear.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb folds the chair semicircle into an ordinary stack.
PANEL 4 — Zib opens the service chase.
PANEL 5 — The HONOR THE PRESENT MOMENT placard is temporarily propped against Zib's tool case.
PANEL 6 — The room is now visibly a maintenance space, not a program.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: Zib finds a binding damper hinge, exactly the ordinary fault he expected. Middle image: The repair is quick and physically legible. Closing image: As airflow returns, Astra watches the room recover faster than any wellness metric can explain.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib exposes the ventilation damper and finds one hinge binding.
PANEL 2 — Mira records the fault and room temperature.
PANEL 3 — Zib frees the hinge and cycles the damper.
PANEL 4 — Air movement visibly returns through hanging paper and condensation patterns.
PANEL 5 — Pixa reports temperature trending toward normal.
PANEL 6 — Astra stands in the now-empty room while the simplest explanation wins.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: Later, nobody restarts the formal session; people simply drift back into the cooler room for ordinary reasons. Middle image: Noola checks the temperature and settles comfortably while Jax retrieves his abandoned coffee. Closing image: The room is demonstrably better before any program tells them how to feel about it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Later, the repaired multipurpose room is cooler and mostly undecorated after the rushed maintenance clear-out.
PANEL 2 — Jax returns for his coffee and stays leaning against the wall.
PANEL 3 — Noola enters, checks her dome temperature and chooses a chair.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb brings the water pitcher back without restarting the session.
PANEL 5 — Zib closes the service log at the doorway.
PANEL 6 — Four coworkers occupy the room comfortably with no timer running.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: We can have both without the soundtrack.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Do not make me responsible for morale.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Only after the physical problem is solved does the administrative problem arrive: the interrupted session still needs a participation state. Middle image: Glorp discovers that participation and disclosure can be recorded separately. Closing image: Astra accepts the local rule that attendance can be complete even when disclosure is blank.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp opens the interrupted-session completion screen in operations.
PANEL 2 — The form separates PARTICIPATION from OPTIONAL REFLECTION.
PANEL 3 — Pixa demonstrates that NO ENTRY is an allowed reflection state.
PANEL 4 — Glorp objects that the blank still becomes a recorded condition.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb points out that the only claim being made is participation occurred and disclosure did not.
PANEL 6 — Astra approves the local completion rule.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Participation can be recorded independently of reflection.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: No entry is still a recorded state.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: Yes. The state is that they did not disclose.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Jax turns in his tracker showing a mindful pause, an incomplete wellness block and no disclosure. Middle image: Noola turns in hers with an early exit caused by room temperature and no disclosure. Closing image: Glorp has to accept two completely different human days as equally valid completed participation records.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax hands Glorp his tracker.
PANEL 2 — It shows MINDFUL PAUSE / SESSION EXIT / DISCLOSURE: NO ENTRY.
PANEL 3 — Noola hands over hers: EARLY EXIT — ENVIRONMENTAL COMFORT / DISCLOSURE: NO ENTRY.
PANEL 4 — Glorp checks that both records satisfy the local rule.
PANEL 5 — Pixa closes both records without creating an emotional category.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I waited for a lift, left a hot room, and disclosed nothing.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Do not make this about me.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Quiet Room. Opening image: The quiet room is being used exactly as intended: no tracker, no program, no conversation requirement. Middle image: Noola rests in her water-dome rig while Astra enters, starts to ask whether she is all right, and decides not to turn the room into another check-in. Closing image: Noola acknowledges the restraint with a small practical kindness.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The quiet room is cool, plain and occupied by Noola and Kreeb.
PANEL 2 — Astra opens the door with the interrupted baseline report in hand.
PANEL 3 — She starts to ask Noola a question, sees the room's NO TALKING REQUIRED sign and stops.
PANEL 4 — Noola looks up.
PANEL 5 — Astra silently points at the repaired-room temperature on her slate, asking only whether the physical condition is acceptable.
PANEL 6 — Noola gives her a thumbs-up through the dome and returns to resting.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: Mira compares the room before, during and after the maintenance interruption. Middle image: The only clean causal result is physical: blocked access delayed a damper repair; the repair improved temperature and comfort conditions. Closing image: The material and wellness effects remain unclaimed.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira lays out the environmental timeline in the repaired multipurpose room.
PANEL 2 — Temperature rises while service access is blocked.
PANEL 3 — Session exits rise during the same period, but Mira does not label motives beyond recorded reasons.
PANEL 4 — Damper repair occurs.
PANEL 5 — Temperature returns toward normal and ordinary room use resumes.
PANEL 6 — Pixa marks WELLNESS ATTRIBUTION: UNAVAILABLE and MATERIAL EFFECT: INDETERMINATE.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: We know the room got hotter.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: We know the damper repair fixed the temperature.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra drafts the baseline report with Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb present. Middle image: Mira reads it. Closing image: Astra sends it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra drafts the baseline report with Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb present.
PANEL 2 — The visible summary records participation, optional disclosure, the maintenance interruption, and no defensible material effect.
PANEL 3 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 4 — Glorp and Kreeb read the same text.
PANEL 5 — Astra sends it.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: participation completed; disclosure optional; NO ENTRY accepted; maintenance interruption changed conditions; no defensible material effect identified.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Corporate response arrives. Middle image: Astra reads it. Closing image: Astra points at the wording.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Corporate response arrives.
PANEL 2 — A second line reframes low disclosure as an interpretability problem.
PANEL 3 — A third line recommends a supplemental initiative.
PANEL 4 — Astra reads it.
PANEL 5 — Pixa opens the participation rule.
PANEL 6 — Astra points at the wording.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Participation in the supplemental initiative is required. Disclosure remains optional.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra, Mira, and Kreeb remain after the reply. Middle image: Astra looks at the corporate message. Closing image: Astra looks at it, then nods.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra, Mira, and Kreeb remain after the reply.
PANEL 2 — Astra leans back.
PANEL 3 — Mira answers immediately.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks at the corporate message.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb points at the accepted NO ENTRY procedure.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at it, then nods.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We gave them nothing and they built another program.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Jax drops his completed wellness tracker on Glorp's desk. Middle image: Jax studies Glorp's expression. Closing image: Jax heads back to work.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax drops his completed wellness tracker on Glorp's desk.
PANEL 2 — He summarizes it.
PANEL 3 — Glorp checks the record.
PANEL 4 — Jax studies Glorp's expression.
PANEL 5 — Glorp considers the new NO ENTRY rule.
PANEL 6 — Jax heads back to work.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I participated. I disclosed nothing. I moved a speaker.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: I am adjusting to a form that permits absence.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Multipurpose Room. Opening image: The corporate wellness banners come down. Middle image: Glorp adds one small line beneath it. Closing image: Glorp looks at her.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The corporate wellness banners come down.
PANEL 2 — Zib restores clear service access to the damper panel.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb keeps the quiet-room sign but removes the StarTrust branding.
PANEL 4 — Glorp adds one small line beneath it.
PANEL 5 — Astra notices the addition.
PANEL 6 — Glorp looks at her.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: A printer produces a fresh corporate placard. Middle image: Jax reads it. Closing image: Jax looks back at the NO ENTRY sign. Astra checks the date: tomorrow.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A printer produces a fresh corporate placard.
PANEL 2 — A smaller participation line appears beneath it.
PANEL 3 — Jax reads it.
PANEL 4 — Noola walks past.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks back at the NO ENTRY sign. Astra checks the date: tomorrow.

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: BRING YOUR FEELINGS TO WORK DAY.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I am bringing mine in a sealed container.
